description: This header file declares the PDUFormatBuilder class used to construct SMS PDU format strings for interfacing with the Cuttlefish modem simulator. It provides methods for setting user data and sender number, and for building the final PDU string according to GSM standards.

classes.name: cuttlefish::PDUFormatBuilder
classes.description: A class that facilitates the construction of SMS PDU (Protocol Data Unit) format strings for sending SMS messages through the Cuttlefish modem simulator. It manages internal state for user data and sender number and provides a method to generate the final PDU string.

methods.name: SetUserData
methods.description: Sets the user data (message content) to be included in the PDU.

methods.name: SetSenderNumber
methods.description: Sets the sender's phone number in the correct international format, adhering to the E.164 specification.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the PDU format string based on the set parameters; returns an empty string if necessary data is invalid.
